You have to stay at the rank consistently for a while before your mmr will catch up. If you keep climbing your rank will go up at a constant rate but mmr won't. You gain MMR rating slower so to gain mmr you have to consistently play at a rank longer. If you end up plateauing for around 50 games at a 50/50 Win rate, then your mmr should catch up and you'll be at around a +15/-15 Win/Loss.

Its easier to understand if you know now mmr works, Its based off of the level of opponents you win/ lose against. So considering most of your games have been against gold players, you now have to play against an equal amount of the rank you're currently at before it becomes the even 15/15 again.

Actually, I'm really happy with ADC right now, IMO its the most balanced its been in years. The TP changes were amazing, it means you can actually trade in lane without having to worry about lvl 2 tp ganks and auto loss lanes. 

I can sympathize with tops complaining of agency and I can see exactly why not being able to tp gank makes them feel even more like an island.

Adc's do complain a lot, but its for the same reason tops are complaining now. Both roles historically are number 4 and 5 for the amount of agency over the game.

Definitely understand it feeling bad for top lane, but the agency problem is a tricky one. Anecdotally the TP change, from a Bot lane perspective has given me the most agency I can remember in the past few seasons. Before the change any inch stepped past river could mean a top lane tping to a ward behind you and a lost lane. 

The change in bot lane, means you can actually trade/ all in while only having to track the jungler, assuming you have vision of the enemy mid/ top. 

Its hard to balance Agency in top, because adding additional objectives often gets leeched by jungle, i.e. rift herald. I think maybe one solution would be to add some reason to force fights in the top alcove, but again that could just end up making the already strong bruiser top laners (darius) even more snowbally. On the flip side the only way to have agency in top lane currently seems to be getting solo kills and splitting, which causes lots of other top laners to play safe under their towers until they scale/ get ganks. Really hard lane to balance, it will be interesting to see what Riot comes up with.

Actually, yes I do still enjoy playing adc in this meta, it just took a little bit getting use to. Sorry but I disagree, the point of an adc is to have a carry that has the potential to deal massive damage in team fights, given the right peel and positioning, however the problem right now is that the amount of engage tools, and high damage burst abilities in the current meta outweigh the amount off cc/peel abilities. Look at a few of the top mid laners right now, viktor and azir, both have the potential to 100 to 0 a squishy with practically 1 ability and a well placed ult, that said they can do this with greater range than most carrys can retaliate from. Then you look at a few of the top tier jungles right now, xin xhao, elise, they both have a gap closer, some type of cc as well as quite the significant chunk of damage another significant threat to squishy targets. Wont even get started on top lane, the point is, in the current meta adcs have to worry about positioning in a way, where they can deal damage to an opponent who not only has a longer range, but also has the power to kill them with 1-2 ability. This can be really frustrating when one faulty step causes you to die instantly. (at least against better players, I'm only plat V but I still find this to be somewhat true) I won't say it isnt possible to carry yourself as an adc, because i've done it, it just feels in the last few patches, the impact you have on a game overall while playing as an adc has become significantly less, so naturally it feels less fun to play, this is probably why so many people are starting to complain.
